'''C-E29''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that operated during the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The droid was present on [[CZ-198]] as a mission courier for Republic forces fighting during the [[Seizure of CZ-198]].<ref name="TOR" />
